name: Kichijouji Escalation Yard
original_name: 吉祥寺エスカレーションヤード
source:
The protagonist "Kou", who was born and raised in Kichijoji, unwillingly spends his days working in a woman's specialty underwear shop.

One day, a chain of bizarre murders occur in the streets of Kichijoji. Every week, a new girl will be kidnapped and raped before being murdered, in an event that has become known as the "Moth of Wednesday"... Eventually, the incident also starts to involve the girls surrounding Kou. "Yeah, I'll protect you! I promise..." But in order to fulfill that promise and to regain peace in your hometown of Kichijoji, he must safely rescue the abducted girls by following the footsteps of the murderers by inspecting the murder scenes and tracking them down. 

A storm starts to brew as things heat up in the darkness of the Neo-Urban City of Kichijoji. If you win the "dart shooting" confrontation with the murderers you can safely rescue the heroine, which begins the love scene, but if defeated, the heroine is raped and murdered by the perpetrators and the game is over.

[Translated from the description on [url=https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/product/B0000Z7PCG?ie=UTF8&redirect=true]Amazon[/url]]
translation:
在吉祥寺出生长大的主人公“寇”，不甘心地在女性内衣专卖店打工。

有一天，吉祥寺街头发生了一系列离奇的谋杀案。每周都会有一名女孩被绑架、强奸，然后被谋杀，这起事件被称为“星期三之蛾”……最终，事件也开始牵涉到寇周围的女孩们。“是的，我会保护你！我保证……”但为了兑现这个承诺，让家乡吉祥寺重获和平，他必须追随凶手的脚步，巡查凶案现场并追查到底，安全营救被绑架的女孩。

随着新城市吉祥寺黑暗中的局势升温，一场风暴开始酝酿。如果你在与凶手的“飞镖射击”对抗中获胜，你就可以安全地救出女主角，从而开始爱情场面，但如果你失败了，女主角就会被凶手强奸和谋杀，游戏结束。

[译自[url=https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/product/B0000Z7PCG?ie=UTF8&redirect=true]Amazon[/url] 上的描述]
